items.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.

confirmed_facts.text: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II) How we optimized Azure Cosmos DB in our application storage platform, Habitat, to manage unprecedented growth.

items.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
items.summary: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.
items.why_relevant: 马斯克限制星链军事用途

confirmed_facts.text: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored - Published Elon Musk has said his company SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink internet service, after Ukrainian officials said connectivity issues appeared to have been resolved.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored - Published Elon Musk has said his company SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink internet service, after Ukrainian officials said connectivity issues appeared to have been resolved.

confirmed_facts.text: The tech billionaire accused Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using it for military activity - but denied being responsible for a simultaneous issue with its US-run, military-grade counterpart Starshield.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The tech billionaire accused Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using it for military activity - but denied being responsible for a simultaneous issue with its US-run, military-grade counterpart Starshield.

confirmed_facts.text: Kyiv has not officially commented on Musk's latest claim but Ukrainian presidential adviser Serhii Beskrestnov said his post was "very strange".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Kyiv has not officially commented on Musk's latest claim but Ukrainian presidential adviser Serhii Beskrestnov said his post was "very strange".

confirmed_facts.text: Musk had earlier denied deliberately throttling Ukraine's connection, which it says hampered its ability to conduct defensive operations for more than a week.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Musk had earlier denied deliberately throttling Ukraine's connection, which it says hampered its ability to conduct defensive operations for more than a week.

confirmed_facts.text: The issue first emerged last week during a broader row between Washington and Kyiv over Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure.

confirmed_facts.text: Musk's latest comments, and the seeming restoration of the service, came after US President Donald Trump said he had told the Tesla and X owner to "put it back", having repeatedly denied instructing him to limit the service.
